title: API Keys
description: Manage your API keys for programmatic access
createApiKeyDescription: Create a new API key to access the MetaMCP API programmatically
name: Name
createFirstApiKey: Create your first API key to get started
confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this API key?
deleteConfirmation: This action cannot be undone. Applications using this API key will lose access.
ownershipDescription: Private API keys are only visible to you. Public API keys can be used by anyone.
keyOnceWarning: For your security, MetaMCP only keeps a fingerprint of this key: it cannot be displayed again. If you lose it, delete it and create a new one.
previewHint: Only the first and last characters are kept for display.
scopeUserDescription: Acts as you on every endpoint you can reach, including the MetaMCP admin tools where an administrator enabled them.
scopeUserOrgDescription: Reaches the endpoints whose namespace is shared with everyone.
scopeEndpointsDescription: Only for using the MCP servers of the endpoints you choose. It cannot administer MetaMCP and stops working on an endpoint its owner loses access to.
editApiKeyDescription: Change the name, the status or what this key can be used for. The key itself stays the same.
activeDescription: An inactive key is refused everywhere until it is enabled again.
nameInvalid: Use only letters, numbers, spaces, underscores and hyphens.
